The Chinese characters for Nicole

As a transliteration, Nicole is usually written 妮科尔 (Nī kē ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Nī
girl, maid
科
kē
science, subject
尔
ěr
you, thus

Origin and meaning

From Greek, Nicole carries the meaning “victory of the people (feminine of Nicholas)”.

About the name Nicole

The feminine of Nicholas, hugely popular in the 1970s and 1980s.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “victory of the people (feminine of Nicholas)”, a Nicole calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
